source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1952, p. 6
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There was no contest: Patrick M'Auley withdrew in Glenshesk, and John M'Caughan was declared elected. A. Price, who had sat for Ballintoy for fifty years, retired and James Gault was nominated in his place. Mr. Patrick M'Auley withdrew his nomination, and M'Caughan was declared elected. Returned unopposed.
